question: A can complete a work in 12 days and B can complete it in 8 days. How long will they take together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct formula for two people working together: Time = (A × B) ÷ (A + B)

⇒ Time = (12 × 8) ÷ (12 + 8)

⇒ Time = 96 ÷ 20

⇒ Time = 4.8 days

**∴ The correct option is (1).**
